author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Sandy Alcantara not expected to be traded
desc: The Miami Marlins are not expected to trade Sandy Alcantara before the trade deadline.
impact: The Marlins intend to keep their ace, Alcantara, but also add to their roster at the deadline, which is three and a half weeks away. The team has been one of the best in baseball as of late, winning 16 of their last 20 games, matching the best single-season span in their 34-year history. Alcantara owns a 4.00 ERA and 1.25 WHIP across 19 starts this season. He's scheduled to pitch on Friday against the Cleveland Guardians, his final outing before the All-Star break.

author: Nate Miller
title: Steven Wilson (back) heads out in rehab assignment
desc: Steven Wilson (back) is set to start a rehab assignment on Friday.
impact: Wilson has yet to pitch for the Rays this season due to a back issue. The club acquired the righty in a trade with the White Sox this past offseason after he posted a 3.42 ERA over 59 relief appearances last year.

author: Nate Miller
title: Kai-Wei Teng (knee) to begin rehab assignment
desc: Kai-Wei Teng (knee) will begin a rehab assignment on Friday.
impact: Teng has missed the past couple of weeks with a knee issue, but the 27-year-old righty is set to begin gearing things up in his rehab process. Teng has posted a respectable 4.36 ERA over 23 appearances (10 starts) for the Astros so far this season.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Carson Whisenhunt escapes control issues in win over Rockies
desc: Carson Whisenhunt allowed two earned runs on three hits and four walks while striking out four over 5 2/3 innings in Thursday's 8-2 win over the Rockies.
impact: Whisenhunt was steady on the mound after being called back up, allowing less than three earned runs in each of his two trips to the mound. The left-hander has benefited from good luck while fighting inconsistent control when called on to toe the rubber for manager Tony Vitello, posting a 3.38 ERA and 1.41 WHIP with a 2-0 record and 1.00 K/BB ratio through two starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Casey Schmitt goes deep, doubles in win over Rockies
desc: Casey Schmitt went 2-for-4 in an 8-2 win over the Rockies with a home run, a double, one walk, two runs scored, and two RBI.
impact: Schmitt has heated up at the plate, recording hits in five of his last seven contests. The 27-year-old offers manager Tony Vitello one of the more impactful options in a streaky Giants lineup to this point, batting .278 with 18 homers, 47 RBI, seven steals, and 41 runs scored across 85 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Willy Adames homers in win over Rockies
desc: Willy Adames went 1-for-5 in Thursday's win over the Rockies with a two-run home run.
impact: Adames continues a solid stretch at the plate of late, picking up hits in nine of his last 13 contests. The shortstop remains another streaky bat in an inconsistent Giants lineup for manager Tony Vitello, batting .229 with 15 homers, 36 RBI, 45 runs scored, and two stolen bases through 88 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Bryce Eldridge goes yard in win over Rockies
desc: Bryce Eldridge went 2-for-3 in Thursday's 8-2 win over the Rockies with a solo home run and two walks.
impact: Eldridge has heated back up at the plate, collecting hits in six of his last eight contests. The first baseman continues to flash his explosive power stroke as one of many streaky options in the Giants lineup, posting an .844 OPS with eight home runs, 20 RBI, and 26 runs scored across 51 games.

author: Nate Miller
title: Thomas Harrington recalled on Friday
desc: Thomas Harrington has been called up from the minors ahead of Friday's game against the Brewers.
impact: The Pirates 12th-ranked prospect per MLB.com, Harrington is set to make his 2026 debut for the club likely at some point this weekend. The first-round draft pick from 2022 made three appearances, including one start, for the Pirates last season, but it did not go well.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Bryse Wilson signs with Brewers
desc: The Milwaukee Brewers have agreed to a contract with Bryse Wilson.
impact: Wilson elected free agency on July 7 after clearing waivers. He owns a 6.52 ERA and 1.55 WHIP across 9.2 innings between the Philadelphia Phillies and Chicago Cubs this season.

author: Nate Miller
title: Antwone recalled on Friday
desc: Antwone Kelly has been called up from Triple-A Indianapolis.
impact: Kelly will make his second trip up to the majors this year. The young righty made his MLB debut for the Pirates back on June 12, allowing two runs on two hits with a walk and a strikeout over 2 1/3 innings. Per MLB.com, Kelly currently ranks as the Pirates No. 7 prospect.

author: Nate Miller
title: Tom Cosgrove to join Nationals on Friday
desc: Tom Cosgrove will be called up ahead of Friday's game against the Yankees.
impact: The Nationals acquired Cosgrove from the Astros just last week. The 30-year-old lefty made one appearance at Triple-A with his new organization, but he will now head up to the bigs to replace Brad Lord (side) in the Nationals' pen.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Michael Soroka (glute) to throw bullpen Sunday and Thursday
desc: Michael Soroka is scheduled to throw a bullpen session on Sunday and Thursday.
impact: Soroka suffered a left glute strain while throwing a warm-up pitch before the start of the second inning in his June 19 outing against the Minnesota Twins. The Arizona Diamondbacks will likely provide a timeline for his return or next steps in his recovery following Thursday's bullpen session.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Justin Martinez (elbow) expected to throw live BP next week
desc: Justin Martinez is expected to throw his first live batting practice session sometime next week.
impact: Martinez underwent Tommy John surgery in June 2025. He continues to make progress in his recovery and will begin facing live hitters soon. He's expected to return to the Diamondbacks at some point in the second half of the season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: A.J. Puk (shoulder) to undergo MRI July 17
desc: A.J. Puk is scheduled to undergo an MRI on July 17 to evaluate the progress of his shoulder injury.
impact: Puk underwent an MRI after experiencing shoulder discomfort following his 24-pitch outing with Triple-A Reno on June 5, revealing a left shoulder capsule sprain. He had been rehabbing from an internal brace procedure he had in June 2025. The Diamondbacks are expected to provide an update on his recovery plan once they receive the MRI results.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Ryne Nelson (elbow) to undergo MRI July 17
desc: Ryne Nelson is scheduled to undergo an MRI on July 17 to evaluate the progress of his elbow recovery.
impact: Nelson was placed on the injured list June 19 with a right UCL sprain after experiencing elbow discomfort while throwing a pitch during his June 16 outing. He has been shut down since, and the Diamondbacks are expected to provide an update on his recovery plan once they receive his MRI results.
